# Build Handoff: Classroom Search and Filters
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Result

The local participant Classroom and administrator Classroom now support server-backed search and filters. The participant view returns published session recordings only; the administrator view returns both published and draft recordings. The implementation covers `LL-12 (Implement search across session and material metadata)` and `LL-13 (Implement category and date filters)` without changing staging, participant onboarding, authentication, or production decisions.

The slice is locally verified. The administrator Classroom filters were checked in the local browser during this session and confirmed working. Full browser visual and responsive evidence for the new controls remains part of the current local validation run.

## Acceptance Coverage

| Requirement | Local behavior |
|---|---|
| `RQ-03 (Participants must filter sessions by category)` | The Classroom category selector applies an exact category filter on the server. |
| `RQ-04 (Participants must filter sessions by date or date range)` | From and To fields apply inclusive server-side date bounds; reversed ranges are rejected. |
| `RQ-05 (Participants must search sessions and supporting-material metadata)` | Search covers session title, category, description, and related protected resource title. |
| Administrator Classroom filtering | Administrators can apply the same search, category, and date filters while retaining access to draft sessions. |

## Security And Scope

- The existing authenticated and active-user middleware still protects the Classroom route.
- The query always starts with published sessions, so drafts are not exposed through search or filters.
- Search uses server-side query constraints and does not expose private resource paths.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, or real participant data were added.
- No staging, production, authentication, participant-data, or deferred feature decision was changed.

## Known Limitations

- The local application still uses SQLite; staging database and deployment evidence remain deferred to next week.
- Browser checks for the participant and administrator filter controls, including light/dark and responsive behavior, are not recorded in this run.
- Participant creation or invitation, authentication and participant-data governance, staging, operations, and final acceptance remain open by direction.

Rollback is limited to the changed source and test files listed above; no migration or persistent data change was introduced. The next action is to include both Classroom views in the current local browser validation, then continue the next approved local feature slice without pushing to staging.
